summary: Clobutinol was pulled from the market worldwide starting in 2007 because of heart harm [3]. A small computer model, rather than tests on people, gave this drug a low score of 18 for liver risk and a medium score of 62 for heart risk [M]. Other drugs with similar chemical structures, such as Chlorphentermine, Propoxyphene, and Cloforex, have also been pulled from markets in various countries due to heart harm or breathing issues [4][5].
